verses.text: The happinesses of the man who walks not in the advice of the wicked, and stands not in the pathway of sinners, and sits not in the seat of scoffers,
verses.heading: Book One

verses.text: but in the instruction of Yahweh {is} his delight, and in his instruction he meditates day and night.
And he is like a tree set to grow by streams of water, which gives its fruit in its season, and its leaf does not wither, and he makes successful all that he does.
Not so the wicked! But {they are} like the chaff that wind chases away.
Thus the wicked will not stand in the judgment, nor sinners in the congregation of the righteous.
For Yahweh knows the way of the righteous, but the way of the wicked will perish.
Why do nations conspire and peoples plot futilely?
The kings of the earth take their stand, and the rulers conspire together against Yahweh and against his anointed.
“Let us tear apart their bonds and cast their cords away from us.”
He who is sitting in the heavens laughs; the Lord mocks them.
Then he will speak to them in his anger and terrify them in his fury,
“I, I have poured out my king on Zion, the mountain of my holiness.”
I will describe a decree of Yahweh. He said to me, “You are my son! Today I have begotten you.
Ask from me, and I will give nations {as} your inheritance and the extremities of the earth {as} your possession.
You will break them with an iron rod; like a jar of a potter, you will smash them to pieces.”
And now kings, act prudently; be admonished, rulers of the earth.
Serve Yahweh with fear and rejoice with trembling.
Kiss the son, lest he be angry and you perish in the way, for his anger burns for just a moment. The happinesses of all the seekers of refuge in him.
Yahweh, how many my oppressors have become! The risers against me are many.
{There are} many sayers about me, “There is no salvation for him in God.” Selah
But you, Yahweh, are a shield round about me, my glory, and the lifter up of my head.
{With} my voice I call to Yahweh, and he answered me from the hill of his holiness. Selah
I laid myself down and slept. I awoke, for Yahweh protects me.
I will not fear the multitudes of people who stand against me round about.
Rise up, Yahweh! Save me, my God! For you hit all my enemies on the cheek; the teeth of the wicked you break.
Salvation {is} of Yahweh. Your blessing {is} on your people. Selah
Answer me when I call, God of my righteousness; in distress you relieve me. Be gracious {to} me and hear my prayer.
Son of man, until when {will} my glory become shame? {Until when} will you love futility, {until when} will you seek falsehood? Selah
But know that Yahweh has set apart the faithful for himself. Yahweh hears when I call to him.
Tremble and do not sin! Meditate in your heart on your bed and be silent. Selah
Sacrifice sacrifices of righteousness and trust in Yahweh.
Many say, “Who will show us good?” Lift up the light of your face on us, Yahweh!
You have put joy in my heart more than the time {when} their grain and their new wine abound.
In peace I will both lie down and sleep, for you alone, Yahweh, cause me to dwell securely.
{To} my words give ear, Yahweh! Understand my murmuring!
Listen attentively to the sound of my cry for help, my king and my God, for to you I pray!
Yahweh, in the morning you hear my voice. In the morning I prepare for you and watch.
For you are not a god pleased with wickedness; evil ones will not sojourn with you.
The arrogant will not stand in front of your eyes; you hate all doers of iniquity.
You will destroy speakers of falsehood; the man of blood and deceit Yahweh abhors.
But I, in the greatness of your covenant faithfulness, I will come into your house; I will bow down toward your temple of holiness in fear.
Yahweh, guide me in your righteousness because of my watchers; straighten before my face your path.
For there is no firmness in his mouth; their inward being is destruction. An open tomb is their throat; their tongue they make smooth.
Make them guilty, God; may they fall due to their schemes! Because of their many transgressions, drive them out, for they rebel against you!
But may all refuge seekers in you rejoice; may they shout joyfully to eternity, and may you cover over them, and may lovers of your name exult in you.
For you, Yahweh, you bless the righteous, you surround him {with} favor as a shield.
Yahweh, rebuke me not in your nose, and in your rage discipline me not.
Be gracious {to} me, Yahweh, for I am frail! Heal me, Yahweh, for my bones are shaking!
And my soul is very disturbed. And you, Yahweh, until when?
Turn back, Yahweh! Rescue my soul! Save me for the sake of your covenant faithfulness!
For in death, there is no remembrance of you. In Sheol, who will thank you?
I am weary with my groaning. During every night, I cause my bed to swim, With my tears, my couch I melt.
My eye has wasted away from grief, it advances because of all my adversaries.
Turn away from me, all you doers of iniquity, for Yahweh has heard the sound of my sobbing!
Yahweh has heard my appeal for mercy, Yahweh accepts my prayer.
Let all my enemies be shamed and greatly disturbed. Let them turn back. Let them be shamed {in} an instant.
Yahweh my God, in you I have taken refuge; save me from all my pursuers, and rescue me!
Lest he rip my life apart like a lion, tearing apart, and there is no one to rescue.
Yahweh my God, if I have done this, if there is wrong on my hands,
if I have repaid evil {to} one {who was at} peace with me, or senselessly rescued my adversary,
let my enemy pursue my soul and overtake {it}, and let him trample my life to the ground and cause my honor to live in the dust. Selah
Arise, Yahweh! In your nose, be lifted with the rage of my adversaries! And wake up for me! You have ordered judgment.
And an assembly of peoples surround you, and over it return on high!
Yahweh, adjudicate the peoples! Judge me, Yahweh, according to my righteousness and according to my integrity, Most High!
May the evil of the wicked end, and {would} you establish the righteous. The righteous God examines hearts and kidneys.
My shield is with God, the savior of the upright of heart.
God is a righteous judge, and a God {who is} indignant on every day.
If he does not repent, his sword he will sharpen, his bow he has bent and prepared.
And for him he has prepared implements of death; he has made his arrows into burning {arrows}.
Behold he is pregnant with wickedness, and he conceives trouble, and he births lies.
He digs a pit and hollows it out and falls into the hole he has made.
His trouble returns on his head, and his violence comes down on the top of his head.
I will thank Yahweh according to his righteousness, and sing praise to the name of Yahweh, the Most High.
Yahweh, our Lord, how magnificent is your name in all the earth, {you} whose splendor is bestowed on the heavens.
Out of the mouth of children and nursing ones you have established strength because of your adversaries, to cause the enemy and avenger to end.
When I look at your heavens, the work of your fingers, the moon and the stars, which you have set in place,
what is mankind that you remember him, or the son of man that you pay attention to him?
Yet you have made him to lack little from the heavenly beings, and {with} glory and majesty you have crowned him.
You made him rule over the works of your hands, everything you have put under his feet:
sheep and oxen—all of them, and also the animals of the field,
birds of the sky, and the fish of the sea, the passers {on} the paths of the seas.
Yahweh, our Lord, how magnificent is your name in all the earth!
I will thank Yahweh with all my heart, I will recount all your wonders.
I will rejoice and exult in you, I will sing praise to your name, Most High!
When my enemies turn back, they stumble and perish from your face.
For you have done my justice and my claim; you have sat on your throne, a judge of righteousness!
You rebuked nations; you destroyed the wicked; you blotted out their name forever and ever.
The enemy are finished—desolation forever, and you pulled up cities. {As for} them, their remembrance perished,
but Yahweh will sit forever. He has established his throne for justice,
as for him, he will judge the world with righteousness, and he will adjudicate for the peoples with fairness.
And may Yahweh be a secure height for the oppressed, a secure height for times with distress.
And may the knowers of your name trust in you, because you have not abandoned the seekers of you, Yahweh.
Sing praises to Yahweh, the sitter {in} Zion! Declare his deeds among the peoples
for the seeker of {vengeance for} bloodshed remembered them; he does not forget the cry of the poor.
Have mercy on me, Yahweh! See my affliction from my haters, O lifter of me from the gates of death,
in order that I might recount all your praise in the gates of the daughter of Zion. I will rejoice in your salvation!
The nations have sunk down into the pit they made; their foot is caught in the net that they hid.
Yahweh has revealed himself, he has done justice; the wicked is ensnared by the work of his hands. Higgaion Selah
The wicked will turn back to Sheol; all nations are forgetful of God.
But the needy will not be forgotten eternally, {nor} will the hope of the afflicted perish forever.
Arise, Yahweh! Let not humanity prevail! On your face let nations be judged.
Put terror to them, Yahweh! May nations know they are human. Selah
Why, Yahweh, do you stand far-off? {Why} do you hide in times of trouble?
In arrogance, the wicked hotly pursue the afflicted; may they be caught by the schemes that they have planned.
Indeed, the wicked boasts about the desires of his soul and he blesses the robber; he despises Yahweh.
According to the haughtiness of his nose the wicked seeks not; All his thoughts {are}, “{There is} no God.”
His ways endure at every time; your judgments are high from in front of him; {as for} all his enemies, he snorts at them.
He says in his heart, “I will not be shaken; to generation and generation {it is I} who {will} not {be} in distress.”
His mouth is full of curses and lies and oppression; under his tongue are mischief and evil.
He sits in ambush near the villages; in the secret places he murders the innocent; his eyes stealthily watch for a helpless person.
He ambushes in a secret place like a lion in cover; he ambushes to seize the afflicted. He seizes the afflicted by pulling in his net.
He stoops, crouches, and unfortunate people fall by his power.
He says in his heart, “God has forgotten; he has hidden his face; to perpetuity he sees not.”
Arise, Yahweh! God, lift up your hand! Do not forget the afflicted ones.
Why does the wicked despise God? He says in his heart, “You will not seek.”
You have seen! Indeed, you notice mischief and vexation to take {it} in your hand. The helpless person entrusts {himself} to you; as for the orphan you, {even} you, are {his} helper.
Break the arm of the wicked and the evil. May it seek his wickedness, {but} not find {it}.
Yahweh is king forever and ever; the nations have perished from his land.
The desire of afflicted ones, you have heard, Yahweh; you strengthen their heart, you cause your ear to attend:
to judge the orphan and oppressed; {that} mankind {who is} from the earth will never again terrify.
To the chief musician; of David. In Yahweh I take refuge. How can you say to my soul, “Flutter {like} a bird to your mountain.
For behold, the wicked, they bend a bow; they have set their arrow on the string to shoot in the darkness at the upright of heart.
If the foundations are destroyed, what can the righteous do”?
Yahweh {is} in his holy temple; Yahweh {is} in the heavens, his throne. His eyes see, his eyelids test the sons of man.
Yahweh tests the righteous and the wicked, and the one loving violence his soul hates.
May he rain snares upon the wicked; fire and brimstone and a scorching wind the portion of their cup!
For Yahweh is righteous, he loves righteousness; the upright will see his face.
Help, Yahweh, for the faithful have come to an end; for the faithful have vanished from {among} the sons of man.
Man, they speak falsehood with his neighbor; they speak {with} lip of smoothness, with a heart and a heart.
May Yahweh cut off all lips of smoothness, the tongue speaking great things,
which say, “With our tongue we will make strong. Our lips {are} with us, who {is} master over us?”
“Because of oppression of the poor, because of {the} groaning of the needy, Now I will arise,” says Yahweh. “I will place in {the} safety he pants for it.”
{The} words of Yahweh {are} pure words, silver refined in a furnace on the ground, purified seven.
You Yahweh, you will keep them. You will protect him from this generation for eternity.
The wicked walk about on every side when vileness is high among the sons of man.
How long, Yahweh? Will you forget me forever? How long will you hide your face from me?
How long must I take counsel in my soul, sorrow in my heart by day? How long will the one being hostile to me be high over me?
Consider {and} answer me, Yahweh my God; give light to my eyes, lest I sleep the {sleep of} death,
Lest the one being hostile to me say, “I have prevailed over him,” {and} my adversaries rejoice when I am shaken.
But I have trusted in your covenant faithfulness; let my heart rejoice in your salvation.
I will sing to Yahweh, because he has dealt bountifully with me.
For the chief musician; of David The fool says in his heart, “No God.” They are corrupt, they do a deed abominably. {There is} none doing good.
Yahweh looks down from the heavens on the sons of man to see whether there is one understanding, one seeking God.
The whole has turned aside. Together they have corrupted themselves. {There is} none doing good, not even one.
Do they not know, all of the doers of iniquity, the ones eating my people {as} they eat bread? They do not call {upon} Yahweh.
There they feared a fear, for God {is} with the generation of the righteous.
You shame the counsel of the afflicted, but Yahweh {is} his refuge.
Who will give the salvation of Israel from Zion? When Yahweh restores the prosperity of his people, Jacob will be glad, Israel will rejoice.
A psalm of David Yahweh, who may sojourn in your tent? Who may dwell on your holy mountain?
The one walking blamelessly, and doing righteousness and speaking truth in his heart.
He does not slander with his tongue, he does not do evil to his neighbor, and an insult he does not raise up against one close to him.
In whose eyes one being rejected is despised, but those who fear Yahweh he honors. He swears to his own hurt, and does not change.
He does not put out his money at interest, and a bribe against the innocent he does not take. The one doing these {things} will not be shaken for eternity.
A miktam of David. Protect me, God, for I take refuge in you.
You said to Yahweh, “You are my Lord; my good is not beyond you.”
As for the holy {ones} who are on the earth, they are the majestic {ones}; all my delight is in them.
Their sorrows will be multiplied, they {who} hasten {after} another {god}. I will not pour out their drink offerings from blood, and I will not take up their names on my lips.
Yahweh, the portion of my inheritance and my cup. You are holding my lot.
{The} measuring cords have fallen for me in pleasant {places}; indeed, {the} inheritance is beautiful for me.
I will bless Yahweh, who has given me counsel; even {in the} night my kidneys instruct me.
I have set Yahweh continually before me, because he is at my right hand, I will not be shaken.
Therefore my heart is glad, and my glory rejoices. Also, my flesh will dwell in security.
For you will not abandon my soul to Sheol. You will not hand over your faithful one to see the pit.
You make known to me the path of life; abundance of joys are before your face; in your right hand are delights forever!
A prayer of David Listen, Yahweh {to} righteousness. Pay attention to my cry! Give ear to my prayer from lips without deceit.
Let my vindication come from your face; let your eyes see rightly!
You have examined my heart, you have visited {me in the} night, you have tested me {and} have detected nothing. I have purposed that my mouth will not transgress.
With regard to the actions of man, by the word of your lips I have kept myself away from the paths of the violent.
My steps hold firmly to your tracks; my footsteps have not slipped.
I have called upon you, for you will answer me, God; Incline your ear to me; listen to my speech.
Set apart your covenant faithfulness, you, the one saving by your right hand the ones seeking refuge {in you} from those rising up!
Keep me as the pupil of your eye; hide me under the shadow of your wings,
from the faces of the wicked who deal violently with me, the ones being hostile against my soul, they surround me.
Their fat they have closed up; with their mouths they speak with pride.
They have surrounded me now {in} our steps. Their eyes they have set, crouching down to the earth.
His likeness is as a lion, he longs to tear; and as a young lion he is dwelling in hiding places.
Arise, Yahweh, confront his face, make him bow down! Rescue my soul from the wicked {with} your sword!

From men {with} your hand Yahweh, from men from {the} world, their portion in life, and with your treasure you fill their belly. They are satisfied with sons, and they leave their abundance to their children.
I, in righteousness, will see your face; when I awake, I will be satisfied {with} your manifestation.
And he said, “I love you, Yahweh, my strength.
Yahweh is my rock and my stronghold and my deliverer; my God, my rock; I take refuge in him, my shield and the horn of my salvation, my high tower.
{To} the one being praised I call, {to} Yahweh, and I am saved from my enemies.
The cords of death encompassed me, and the torrents of wickedness terrified me.
The cords of Sheol surrounded me; the snares of death confronted me.
In my distress, I called {to} Yahweh, and to my God I cried out for help. He heard my voice from his temple, and my cry to his face went in his ears.
Then the earth shook and trembled, and the foundations of the mountains quaked and shook themselves because it burned to him.
Smoke went up from his nose, and fire from his mouth devoured. Coals from him burned.
And he lowered the heavens, and he came down, and a dark cloud was under his feet.
And he rode on a cherub, and he flew, and he flew swiftly on the wings of the wind.
He set darkness his covering, the booth around him {was} a darkness of waters, clouds of the skies.
From the brightness before him, hailstones and coals of fire broke through his thick clouds.
And Yahweh thundered in the heavens and the Most High uttered his voice, hailstones and coals of fire.
And he sent out his arrows and he scattered them and lightnings in abundance and he panicked them.
And the channels of the sea were seen, and the foundations of the world were uncovered, from your rebuke, Yahweh, from the blast of the breath of your nose.
He stretched out from the height, he took hold of me. He drew me out of many waters.
He delivered me from my strong enemy, from the ones hating me, for they were stronger than me.
They confronted me on the day of my calamity, but Yahweh was my support!
And he brought me out to an open space; he delivered me because he delighted in me.
Yahweh has rewarded me according to my righteousness, according to the cleanness of my hands he has given back to me.
For I have kept the ways of Yahweh, and I have not been wicked from my God.
For all of his judgments {are} before me, and his statutes, I have not turned away from them.
And I have been blameless with him, and I have kept myself from my iniquity.
And Yahweh has given back to me according to my righteousness, according to the cleanness of my hands before his eyes.
With the faithful you show yourself faithful; with a blameless man, you show yourself blameless.
With the purified, you show yourself pure, but with the crooked, you show yourself cunning.
For you save a lowly people, but the eyes {of} the ones being high, you bring them down.
For you light my lamp; Yahweh my God lightens my darkness.
For by you I run {after} a troop, and by my God I leap {over} a wall.
This God, his way {is} perfect. The word of Yahweh is refined. He {is} a shield to all of the ones taking refuge in him.
For who is God except Yahweh? And who is a rock except our God?
This God is the one girding me {with} valor, and he makes my way perfect,
making my feet like a deer, and he makes me stand on my high places,
training my hands for war, and my arms bend a bow of bronze.
And you give to me the shield of your salvation, and your right hand supports me, and your humility makes me great.
You enlarge my step under me, and my feet do not slip.
I pursue my enemies, and I destroy them, and I do not return until I have ended them.
I severely wounded them so that they were not able to rise; they fell under my feet.
And you gird me {with} valor for war; you make the ones rising up under me bow down.
And my enemies, you give to me the back of {their} neck; the ones hating me, I destroyed them.
They called out for help, but there was none saving; to Yahweh, but he did not answer them.
And I beat them fine as dust upon the face of the wind; like the mud of the streets I cast them out.
You rescue me from the disputes of people. You made me as the head of nations. People I did not know serve me.
At the hearing of an ear, they hear me; sons of the foreigner cringe to me.
Sons of the foreigner fade away, and they come trembling from their fortresses.
Yahweh is alive! And blessed be my rock, and may the God of my salvation be exalted,
the God giving vengeance to me, and he subdues peoples under me,
the one delivering me from my enemies. Also, from the ones arising {against} me you lift me up, from a man of violence, you deliver me.
Therefore, I thank you among the nations, Yahweh; and I will sing praise to your name,
the one magnifying the salvation of his king and doing covenant faithfulness to his anointed, to David, and to his seed until forever.”
The heavens are declaring the glory of God, and the sky is proclaiming the work of his hands.
Day to day makes flow forth a word, and night to night declares knowledge.
{There} is no speech and {there} are no words, their voice is not being heard.
Their line has gone out through all of the earth, and their words to the end of the world. He has set in them a tent for the sun,
and that is like a bridegroom coming out from his chamber, it rejoices like a strong man to run its path.
From the end of the heavens is its going forth, and its circuit to the ends of them, and there is nothing hidden from its heat.
The law of Yahweh is perfect, restoring the soul; the testimony of Yahweh is sure, making wise the simple.
The precepts of Yahweh are right, making the heart rejoice; the commandment of Yahweh is pure, enlightening the eyes.
The fear of Yahweh is clean, enduring forever; the judgments of Yahweh are true, they are altogether righteous.
They are to be desired more than gold, and more than much fine gold, and they are more sweet than honey and nectar of honeycombs.
Also, by them your servant is warned; in keeping them there is great reward.
Who can discern {his} errors? Acquit me from hidden {faults}.
Also, keep back your servant from presumptuous ones; let them not rule over me. Then I will be blameless, and I will be innocent from great transgression.
Let the words of my mouth and the meditation of my heart be acceptable to your face, Yahweh, my strength and the one redeeming me.
May Yahweh answer you in the day of trouble; may the name of the God of Jacob set you on high.
May he send you help from the sanctuary and support you from Zion.
May he remember all of your grain offerings and regard as fat your burnt offering. Selah
May he grant you according to your heart, and may he fulfill all of your plans.
We will shout for joy over your salvation, and in the name of our God we will set up {our} banners. May Yahweh fulfill all of your petitions.
Now I know that Yahweh saves his anointed; he will answer him from his holy heaven with mighty deeds of salvation of his right hand.
These in chariots and these in horses, but we will remember the name of Yahweh our God.
They bow down and fall, but we rise and stand upright!
Save, Yahweh; may the king answer us on the day we call.
Yahweh, in your strength the king rejoices, and in your salvation how greatly he exults!
You have given to him the desire of his heart, and the request of his lips you have not withheld. Selah
For you meet him with blessings of good; you place on his head a crown of refined gold.
He asked life from you; you gave {it} to him, length of days, forever and ever.
His glory is great through your salvation; splendor and majesty you place on him.
For you place on him eternal blessings; you make him glad with joy with your face.
For the king is trusting in Yahweh, and through the covenant faithfulness of the Most High, he will not be shaken.
Your hand will find all of your enemies; your right hand will find the ones hating you.
You will make them as an oven of fire at the time of your face. In his nose Yahweh will swallow them and will consume them {with} fire.
You will destroy their fruit from the earth and their seed from {among} the sons of man.
Though they stretch out evil against you, they plan a plot they will not be able.
For you will make them shoulder; on your strings you will set {your arrows} toward their faces.
Be exalted, Yahweh, in your strength; we will sing and we will praise your power.
My God, my God, why have you forsaken me? {Why are you} far from the salvation of me, {far from} the words of my groaning?
My God, I call by day, but you do not answer, and {in} the night, and there is no silence for me.
Yet you are holy, sitting {in} the praises of Israel.
In you our fathers trusted; they trusted, and you delivered them.
To you they cried and they were rescued. In you they trusted and they were not ashamed.
But I am a worm and not a man, a reproach of mankind and despised by the people.
All of the ones seeing me mock me; they open wide with the lip. They shake the head,
“Roll to Yahweh; let him deliver him. Let him rescue him, since he delights in him.”
Yet you are the one pulling me out from the womb, making me trust upon the breasts of my mother.
Upon you I was cast from the womb; from the womb of my mother, you {have been} my God.
You {do} not be far away from me, for trouble is near, for {there is} no one helping {me}.
Many bulls surround me; strong ones of Bashan encircle me.
They open their mouths against me, a tearing and roaring lion.
I am poured out like water, and all of my bones are dislocated. My heart is like wax; it has melted within my inner parts.
My strength is dried up like a shard, and my tongue is being made to cling to my gums, and to the dust of death you lay me.
For dogs have surrounded me; a company of ones doing evil have encircled me, like the lion, my hands and my feet.
I can count all of my bones. They look {and} they stare at me.
They divide my garments among them, and they cast lots for my clothing.
But you, Yahweh, {do} not be far away. My strength, hurry to help me.
Deliver my life from the sword, my only one from the hand of the dog.
Save me from the mouth of the lion, and from the horns of wild oxen, answer me.
I will declare your name to my brothers; in the midst of the assembly I will praise you.
You who fear Yahweh, praise him! All of the seed of Jacob, honor him, and be terrified from him, all of the seed of Israel!
For he has not despised nor abhorred the affliction of the afflicted, and he has not hidden his face from him, but when he cried to him, he heard.
From with you my praise in the great assembly; I will fulfill my vows before those who fear him.
The poor will eat and be satisfied. The ones seeking Yahweh will praise. May your heart live forever.
All of the ends of the earth will remember and turn to Yahweh, and all of the families of the nations will bow down to your face.
For to Yahweh the kingdom, and he is ruling over the nations.
All of the fat of the earth will eat and will bow down; to his face will kneel all of the ones going down to the dust, even his self he kept not alive.
Seed will serve him; it will be told of the Lord to the generation.
They will come and will declare his righteousness to a people who will be born, that he has done {it}!
A psalm of David Yahweh is my shepherd; I will lack nothing.
He makes me lie down in green pastures; he leads me to waters of rest.
He restores my soul. He leads me in right paths for the sake of his name.
Even though I walk through {the} valley of deep darkness, I will fear no evil, for you are with me; your rod and your staff, they comfort me.
You arrange a table before my face in front of my enemies; you have anointed my head with oil; my cup overflows.
Surely goodness and covenant faithfulness will pursue me all the days of my life, and I will dwell in the house of Yahweh for length of days!
A psalm of David To Yahweh {is} the earth and its fullness, the world and the ones dwelling in it.
For he has founded it upon the seas and established it upon the rivers.
Who may ascend on the mountain of Yahweh? And who may stand in his holy place?
{The} one clean of hands and pure of heart, who has not lifted up his soul to what is false, and has not sworn deceitfully.
He will take up a blessing from Yahweh and righteousness from the God of his salvation.

As a deer pants for streams of water, so my soul pants for you, God.
verses.heading: Book Two

verses.text: My soul thirsts for God, for the living God. When will I come and appear to the face of God?
My weeping is bread to me day and night, in {their} saying to me all of the day, “Where {is} your God?”

Let me remember these, and let me pour out my soul within me, that I went over with the crowd. I led them in procession to the house of God with a voice of rejoicing and praise, a multitude celebrating a festival.
Why have you bowed yourself down, my soul, and are clamoring within me? Wait for God, for I will again thank him, the salvation of his face.
My God, my soul has bowed itself down within me. Therefore I will remember you from the land of the Jordan and the Hermons, from Mount Mizar.
Deep is calling to deep at the sound of your waterfalls. All of your breakers and your waves pass over me.
{By} day, Yahweh commands his covenant faithfulness, and at night, his song {is} with me, a prayer to the God of my life.
Let me say to God, my rock, “Why have you forgotten me? Why do I walk about mourning because of the oppression of the enemy?”
With crushing in my bones, the ones afflicting me reproach me in their saying to me all of the day, “Where is your God?”
Why have you bowed yourself down, my soul, and why are you clamoring within me? Wait for God, for I will again thank him, the salvation of my face and my God.
Vindicate me, God, and plead my plea against a nation not faithful. Rescue me from a deceitful and unjust man.
For you {are} the God of my refuge. Why have you rejected me? Why do I walk about mourning because of the oppression of the enemy?
Send out your light and your faithfulness, them, let them lead me. Let them bring me to the mountain of your holiness and to your dwellings.
Let me come to the altar of God, to the God of the joy of my gladness. I will thank you with the lyre, God, my God.
Why have you bowed yourself down, my soul, and why are you clamoring within me? Wait for God, for I will again thank him, the salvation of my face and my God.
God, we have heard with our ears, our fathers have recounted to us, the work you worked in their days, in the days of antiquity.
You, you drove out the nations {by} your hand, but you planted them. You caused harm to the peoples, but you sent them.
For they did not possess the land with their sword, and their arm did not save them, but your right hand and your arm and the light of your face, for you favored them.
You {are} he, my king, God. Command the salvation of Jacob.
By you we gore our enemies; by your name we trample the ones arising {against} us.
For I do not trust in my bow, and my sword does not save me,
but you save us from our enemies, and you shame the ones hating us.
In God we boast all of the day, and we will praise your name forever. Selah
But you have rejected and humiliated us, and you do not go out with our armies.
You make us turn back from the enemy, and the ones hating us plunder for themselves.
You have made us like sheep of food, and you have scattered us among the nations.
You have sold your people for not-wealth, and you have not increased by their price.
You have made us a reproach to our neighbors, a scorn and a derision to {those} around us.
You have made us a proverb among the nations, a shaking of the head among the peoples.
All of the day my disgrace {is} before me, and the shame of my face covers me,
from the voice of one reproaching and one reviling, from the face of an enemy and one avenging.
All of this has come {to} us, but we have not forgotten you and we have not dealt falsely with your covenant.
Our heart has not turned itself back, nor have our steps turned aside from your way.
But you have crushed us into a place of jackals, and you have covered over us with a dark shadow.
If we had forgotten the name of our God and spread out our palms to a foreign god,
would God not have discovered this? For he is knowing the secrets of the heart.
But because of you we are killed all of the day, we are considered like sheep of slaughter.
Awake! Why are you sleeping, Lord? Wake up! Do not reject {us} forever!
Why do you hide your face, forget our affliction and our oppression?
For our soul has sunk down into the dust, our belly clings to the earth.
Arise {as} a helper to us and redeem us because of your covenant faithfulness.
My heart boils over {with} a good matter. I am reciting my works to the king. My tongue is the stylus of a quick scribe.
You are fairer than the sons of man. Grace is poured onto your lips. Therefore God has blessed you forever.
Gird your sword on your thigh, warrior, {in} your glory and your majesty.
And {in} your majesty prosper, ride out for the sake of truth and humility {and} righteousness. May your right hand teach you fearful things.
Your arrows are sharp; the peoples fall under you; in the heart of the enemies of the king.
Your throne, God, {is} forever and ever. A scepter of justice {is} the scepter of your kingdom.
You love righteousness, and you hate wickedness. Therefore God, your God, has anointed you {with} the oil of joy more than your companions.
Myrrh and aloes, cassia, {are} all of your garments. From palaces of ivory, stringed instruments make you rejoice.
Daughters of kings {are} among your precious {ones}. The queen is stationed at your right hand in gold of Ophir.
Listen, daughter, and consider, and incline your ear, and forget your people and the house of your father.
Then the king will desire your beauty. Because he is your lord, prostrate yourself to him.
The daughter of Tyre with a gift; the rich of the people will entreat your face.
All glorious {is} the daughter of the king within; from interweavings of gold {is} her clothing.
She will be led to the king in embroidery. The virgins after her, her companions, will be brought to you.
They will be led by joy and rejoicing; they will enter into the palace of the king.
In place of your fathers will be your sons; you will make him princes in all of the earth.
Let me make {people} remember your name in every generation to generation; therefore the peoples will thank you forever and ever.
God {is} to us a refuge and strength, being found greatly a help in trouble.
Therefore we will not fear in the changing of the earth and the shaking of the mountains into the heart of the seas,
should its waters roar and foam, should the mountains quake at its swelling. Selah
A stream, its channels make the city of God rejoice, the holy {place} of the dwellings of the Most High.
God {is} in the midst of her, she will not be shaken. God will help her at the turning of the morning.
Nations may roar; kingdoms may shake. He utters with his voice; the earth melts.
Yahweh of Armies {is} with us; the God of Jacob {is} a stronghold to us. Selah
Come, see the works of Yahweh, who makes desolations on the earth,
making wars cease to the end of the earth. He shatters the bow and cuts the spear in pieces; he burns the wagons with fire.
“Be still and know that I {am} God. I will be high among the nations, I will be high on the earth.”
Yahweh of Armies {is} with us; the God of Jacob {is} a stronghold to us. Selah
Clap a palm, all peoples! Shout to God with a voice of rejoicing.
For Yahweh, the Most High, is to be feared, the great king over all of the earth.
He subdues peoples under us and nations under our feet.
He chose our inheritance for us, the pride of Jacob, whom he loved. Selah
God has gone up with a shout, Yahweh with the sound of a shofar.
Sing praise {to} God, sing praise! Sing praise {to} our king, sing praise!
For God {is} the king of all of the earth. Sing praise {with} a maskil.
God reigns over the nations; God sits on the throne of his holiness.
The nobles of the peoples will gather themselves {as} the people of the God of Abraham, for {to} God are the shields of the earth. He is greatly exalted!
Yahweh is great, and he is being praised greatly in the city of our God, {on} the mountain of his holiness.
Beautiful of elevation, the joy of all of the earth, {is} Mount Zion {in} the recesses of the north, the city of the great king.
God {is} in her citadels. He is known as a stronghold.
For behold, kings assembled themselves, they advanced together.
They, they saw, then they marveled. They were terrified, they hastened themselves away.
Trembling seized them there, pain like childbearing.
With the wind of the east, you shatter ships of Tarshish.
As we have heard, so we have seen in the city of Yahweh of Armies, in the city of our God. God will establish it to forever. Selah
We have compared your covenant faithfulness, God, in the midst of your temple.
As {is} your name, God, so {is} your praise to the ends of the earth. Your right hand is full {of} righteousness.
Let Mount Zion rejoice, let the daughters of Judah be glad, because of your judgments.
Circle Zion and go around her. Count her towers,
put your heart to her rampart, consider her citadels, so that you may recount to a later generation.
For this God {is} our God forever and ever. He, he will guide us until death.
Hear this, all peoples! Listen, all dwellers of the world,
both sons of a human and sons of a man, the rich and the poor together.
My mouth will speak wisdom, and the meditation of my heart, understanding.
I will incline my ear to a proverb; I will open my enigma with a harp.
Why should I fear in the days of evil, {when} the iniquity of my heels surrounds me,
the ones trusting in their wealth, and in the abundance of their treasure they boast?
Redeeming, a man does not redeem a brother, he does not give his ransom to God.
For the redemption of their life is costly, and it ceases forever,
that one should live on forever, {that} one should not see the pit.
For one will see. The wise die, likewise the fool and the brute perish, and they leave their wealth to others.
Inside of them, their houses {are} forever, their dwellings {are} to generation and generation. They call over lands by their names.
But a human does not abide in honor. He is likened to the beasts, they are destroyed.
This, their way, {is} folly to them, but after them, they delight in their mouths. Selah
Like sheep, they appoint {them} to Sheol; death will shepherd them. And the upright will rule over them in the morning, and Sheol will consume their form from the dwelling to it.
But God will redeem my soul from the hand of Sheol, for he will take me. Selah
Do not fear when a man becomes rich, when the glory of his house increases.
For in his death, he will not take anything; his glory will not go down after him.
Although in his life he blesses his soul (and they do praise you when you do well for yourself),
he will come to the generation of his fathers; forever they will not see light.
A human in honor, but he does not understand, he is likened to the beasts, they are destroyed.
A Psalm of Asaph The God of gods, Yahweh, has spoken, and he has summoned the earth from the rising of the sun to its setting.
From Zion, the perfection of beauty, God has shined forth.
Our God comes, and he is not silent. A fire devours to his face, and around him it is stormed greatly.
He calls to the heavens above and to the earth so that he may judge his people.
“Gather my faithful {ones} to me, the cutters of my covenant by sacrifice.”
The heavens declare his righteousness, that God, he is judge. Selah
“Hear, my people, and I will speak; Israel, and I will testify against you. I {am} God, your God.
I do not accuse you regarding your sacrifices, for your burnt offerings are always before me.
I will not take a bull from your house, goats from your folds.
For every beast of the forest {is} to me, the cattle on a thousand hills.
I know all the birds of the mountains, and the creature of the field {is} with me.
If I were hungry, I would not say {that} to you, for the world and its fulness {are} to me.
Do I eat the flesh of bulls, or do I drink the blood of goats?
Sacrifice a thank offering to God, and pay your vows to the Most High.
Call on me in the day of trouble; I will deliver you, and you will glorify me.”
But to the wicked {one} God says, “What to you to recount my statutes, or that you should lift up my covenant onto your mouth?
For you, you hate instruction, and you cast my words behind you.
When you see a thief, you approve of him, and you partake with adulterers.
You send your mouth in evil, and your tongue frames deceit.
You sit, you speak against your brother; you impute slander against the son of your mother.
You have done these {things}, but I have been silent. You thought the being of I AM {was} like you. I will accuse you, and let me array to your eyes.
Consider this now, forgetters of God, lest I tear and none be delivering!
The one sacrificing a thank offering glorifies me, and the one placing a way, I will make him look upon the salvation of God.”
Be merciful to me, God, according to your covenant faithfulness. According to the multitude of your compassions, wipe away my transgressions.
Make great, wash me from my iniquity, and cleanse me from my sin.
For I, I know my transgressions, and my sin {is} always before me.
Against you, you only, I have sinned and done evil in your eyes, so you are right in your speaking, you are blameless in your judging.
Behold, I was born in iniquity, and in sin my mother conceived me.
Behold, you desire truth in the kidneys, and you teach me wisdom in the closed {place}.
May you purify me with hyssop, that I may be clean. May you wash me, that I may be whiter than snow.
Make me hear joy and gladness; may the bones you have crushed rejoice.
Hide your face from my sins, and wipe away all of my iniquities.
Create for me a clean heart, God, and renew an established spirit within me.
May you not cast me away from your face, and may you not take the Spirit of your holiness from me.
Restore to me the joy of your salvation, and support me {with} a willing spirit.
Let me teach transgressors your ways, that sinners may return to you.
Deliver me from blood, God, the God of my salvation, may my tongue sing {about} your righteousness.
Lord, may you open my lips, that my mouth may declare your praise.
For you do not delight in sacrifice, or I would give {it}; you do not accept a burnt offering.
The sacrifices of God {are} a broken spirit. A broken and crushed heart, God, you will not despise.
Do good to Zion in your acceptance; build the walls of Jerusalem.
Then you will delight in sacrifices of righteousness, a burnt offering and a whole {one}. Then they will offer bulls on your altar.
Why do you boast about harm, O warrior? The covenant faithfulness of God all of the day.
Like a sharpened razor, your tongue devises calamities, worker of betrayal!
You love evil more than good, lying more than speaking righteousness. Selah
You love all words of destruction, tongue of betrayal!
God will also tear you down forever. He will take you away and tear you from the tent and uproot you from the land of the living. Selah
And the righteous will see and fear, and they will laugh at him.
“Behold, the man did not make God his refuge, but he trusted in the abundance of his wealth; he was strong in his calamity.”
But I {am} like a green olive tree in the house of God. I will trust in the covenant faithfulness of God forever and ever.
I will thank you forever, for you have done {this}. I will await your name, for {it is} good before your faithful {ones}.
The fool says in his heart, “No God.” They are corrupt, and they do iniquity abominably. {There is} none doing good.
God looks down from the heavens on the sons of man to see whether there is one understanding, one seeking God.
All of him has turned away. Together they have corrupted themselves. {There is} none doing good, not even one.
Do they not know, the doers of iniquity, the ones eating my people {as} they eat bread? They do not call {upon} God.
There they feared a fear {when} no fear was, because God scattered the bones of the one encamping against you. You have shamed {them}, for God despises them.
Who will give the salvation of Israel from Zion? When God restores the prosperity of his people, Jacob will be glad, Israel will rejoice.
Save me, God, by your name, and vindicate me by your might.
Hear my prayer, God; listen to the words of my mouth.
For foreigners have arisen against me, and violent {ones} seek my life. They do not set God before them. Selah
Behold, God is a helper to me; the Lord {is} with the sustainers of my life.
He will return harm to my enemies. In your faithfulness, destroy them!
With a freewill offering, I will sacrifice to you. I will praise your name, Yahweh, for {it is} good.
For he delivers me from every trouble, and my eye looks at my enemies.
Listen {to} my prayer, God, and do not hide yourself from my plea.
Attend to me and answer me. I am restless in my complaint, and let me moan
from the voice of the enemy, from the face of the oppression of the wicked. For they shake trouble onto me, and in nose they persecute me.
My heart writhes in the midst of me, and the terrors of death have fallen onto me.
Fear and trembling have come on me, and horror has covered me.
I have said, “Who will give the wing of a dove to me? Let me fly away and let me dwell.
Behold, I would make distance, wandering; I would lodge in the wilderness. Selah
Let me hasten for myself {to} an escape from the storming wind, from the tempest.”
Swallow {them}, Lord, divide their tongue! For I have seen violence and strife in the city.
Day and night they go around it on its walls, and iniquity and trouble {are} in the midst of it.
Calamity {is} in the midst of it, and oppression and deceit do not depart from its open square.
For an enemy does not reproach me; then I would bear {it}. One hating me has not made great against me; then I would hide myself from him.
But {it was} you, a man according to my valuation, my companion and my acquaintance,
we who together made counsel sweet; we walked in the house of God with the throng.
{May} desolations {be} upon them; may they go down {to} Sheol alive, for evils {are} in their dwelling, in the midst of them.
I, I will call to God, and Yahweh will save me.
Evening and morning and noon, let me complain and moan, and he will hear my voice.
He redeems my life in peace from the battle against me, for with many they are against me.
God will hear and answer them, even the one sitting {from} antiquity, Selah to whom {there are} no changes, so they do not fear God.
He stretches out his hands against his friends; he defiles his covenant.
The curds of his mouth were smooth, but his heart {was} war. His words were softer than oil, but they {were} unsheathed {swords}.
Cast your burden on Yahweh, and he, he will sustain you. Forever he will not allow shaking to the righteous.
But you, God, will make them go down to the pit of the grave. Men of blood and treachery will not halve their days. But I, I will trust in you.
Be gracious to me, God, for man tramples me! All of the day, fighting, he oppresses me.
My enemies trample me all of the day, for many are fighting against me arrogantly.
The day I fear, I, I will trust in you.
In God—I praise his word—in God I trust. I will not fear. What will flesh do to me?
All of the day they vex my matters; all of their thoughts {are} against me for harm.
They gather together, they hide; they, they watch my heels because they await my life.
Upon iniquity {shall there be} an escape for them? In nose, make the peoples go down, God.
You, you record my wandering. Put my tears in your bag. {Are they} not in your record?
Then my enemies will turn back on the day I call. This I know, for God {is} for me.
In God—I praise his word— in Yahweh—I praise his word—
in God I trust. I will not fear. What will man do to me?
Your vows {are} on me, God. I will pay a thank-offering to you.
For you deliver my life from death. {Are} not my feet from stumbling, that I may walk about to the face of God in the light of the living?
Be gracious to me, God, be gracious to me, for in you my soul takes refuge, and in the shadow of your wings I take refuge until the calamities have passed by.
I call to God Most High, to God, the one accomplishing for me.
May he send from the heavens and save me. May he reproach the one trampling me. Selah May God send his covenant faithfulness and his truth.
My soul {is} in the midst of lions; I must lie down {among} blazing ones, sons of man. Their teeth {are} a spear and arrows, and their tongue {is} a sharp sword.
Be high above the heavens, God, {may} your glory {be} above all of the earth.
They prepare a net for my steps; my soul bows down. They dig a pit to my face; they fall into the midst of it. Selah
My heart is established, God, my heart is established. Let me sing and make music.
Awake, my glory! Awake, lyre and harp! Let me awaken the dawn.
I will thank you, Lord, among the peoples; I will make music to you among the nations.
For your covenant faithfulness {is} great to the heavens, and your truth to the clouds.
Be high above the heavens, God, {may} your glory {be} above all of the earth.
Truly {in} silence do you speak righteousness? Do you judge uprightly, sons of man?
No, in the heart you do wickedness. Your hands weigh out violence on the earth.
The wicked turn aside from the womb; they stray from the belly, speaking falsehood.
The poison to them {is} like the likeness of the poison of a serpent. {They are} like a deaf adder {that} shuts its ears,
that does not listen to the voice of charmers, one charming charms, being made wise.
God, break their teeth in their mouth! Break out the fangs of the young lions, Yahweh!
May they be melted like waters {that} run off to them. {When} he treads his arrows, {may they be} as if they are cut off.
{May they be} like a snail {that} melts; it goes away. {May they be like} the miscarriage of a woman; they do not see the sun.
Before your pots perceive the thorn, like the living, like the burning, he will whirlwind it away.
The righteous will rejoice when he sees vengeance. He will wash his feet in the blood of the wicked.
Then man will say, “Truly, fruit {is} to the righteous. Truly, there is a God judging the earth.”
Deliver me from my enemies, my God! Set me on high, away from the ones rising up against me.
Deliver me from workers of iniquity, and save me from men of blood.
For behold, they lie in wait for my life; the mighty gather against me. Not {for} my transgression and not {for} my sin, Yahweh,
without iniquity, they run and prepare themselves. Awake to meet me, and see!
So you, Yahweh, God of armies, the God of Israel, wake up to punish all of the nations! Do not be gracious {to} any treacherous workers of iniquity. Selah
They return at evening, they growl like a dog and go around the city.
Behold, they belch out with their mouth, swords {are} in their lips, for, “Who is hearing?”
But you, Yahweh, laugh at them. You mock all of the nations.
Let me wait for you, his strength, for God {is} my stronghold.
The God of my covenant faithfulness will meet me. God will make me look upon my enemies.
Do not slay them, lest my people forget. Scatter them by your power and bring them down, Lord, our shield.
{For} the sin of their mouth, the word of their lips, may they be taken in their pride, and for the curse and for the lying they tell.
Consume {them} in wrath; consume {them} that they {may} not {be}, that they may know that God is ruling in Jacob to the ends of the earth. Selah
They return at evening; they growl like a dog and go around the city.
They, they wander around to eat. If they are not full, then they lodge.
But I, I will sing {about} your strength, and I will sing aloud in the morning {about} your covenant faithfulness! For you are a stronghold to me and a refuge in the day of trouble to me.
Let me make music to you, my strength, for God {is} my stronghold, the God of my covenant faithfulness.
God, you have rejected us; you have broken through us. You have become angry; restore us!
You have made the earth tremble; you have broken it. Heal its breaches, for it shakes.
You have made your people see the difficult. You have made us drink the wine of staggering.
You have given a banner to the ones fearing you, to be displayed from the face of the bow. Selah
So that your beloved may be delivered, save {us} {with} your right hand and answer me.
God has spoken in his holiness, “I will rejoice; I divide Shechem and measure out the Valley of Succoth.
To me {is} Gilead, and to me {is} Manasseh. And Ephraim {is} the protection of my head; Judah, my scepter.
Moab is the tub of my washing. Over Edom I throw my sandal. Over me, Philistia, shout triumphantly.”
Who will bring me {into} the city of fortification? Who will lead me to Edom?
You, God, have you not rejected us? And you do not go out with our armies, God.
Give help against the enemy to us, for the salvation of man {is} futility.
With God we will do valor, for he, he will trample our adversaries.
Hear my cry, God; listen {to} my prayer.
From the end of the earth I call to you when my heart is faint. Lead me to the rock {that} is higher than me.
For you are a refuge to me, a strong tower from the face of the enemy.
Let me sojourn in your tent forever! I will take refuge in the shelter of your wings. Selah
For you, God, have listened to my vows. You have given {me} the inheritance of the fearers of your name.
Days upon days of the king, may you add {to} his years, as generation and generation.
May he dwell forever to the face of God. Appoint covenant faithfulness and truth; may they preserve him.
Thus let me make music {to} your name forever, that I may pay my vows day, day.
Truly toward God my soul {is in} silence. From him {is} my salvation.
He alone {is} my rock and my salvation, my stronghold. I will not be greatly shaken.
Until when will you shout at a man? You will be smashed, all of you, like a leaning wall, an overthrown fence.
They consult only to cast {him} down from his elevation. They delight {in} a lie; with his mouth, they bless, but in their inside, they curse. Selah
Be silent, my soul, toward God alone, for my hope is from him.
He alone {is} my rock and my salvation, my stronghold. I will not be shaken.
In God {is} my salvation and my glory; the rock of my strength, my refuge, {is} in God.
Trust in him in every time, people. Pour out your heart to his face. God {is} a refuge for us. Selah
Surely sons of a human {are} vapor, sons of a man {are} a lie. To go up on the scales, they together {would be lighter} than vapor.
Do not trust in oppression, and do not hope vainly in robbery. Wealth, if it increases, do not set the heart.
Once God has spoken, twice I have heard this, that power {is} to God.
Also to you, Lord, {is} covenant faithfulness, for you, you repay to a man according to his doing.
God, you {are} my God. I seek you earnestly. My soul thirsts for you, my flesh faints for you in a land of dryness and weary, without water.
Thus in the sanctuary I have gazed {at} you to see your power and your glory.
Because your covenant faithfulness {is} better than life, my lips will praise you.
Thus I will bless you in my life; I will lift up my palms in your name.
As {with} fat and fatness my soul will be full, and {with} lips of joyful shouts my mouth will praise {you}.
When I remember you on my bed, I meditate on you in the night watches.
For you have been a help to me, and in the shadow of your wings I shout joyfully.
My soul clings after you; your right hand upholds me.
But they, they seek my life for devastation; they will come into the lowest parts of the earth.
They will pour him into the hands of the sword; they will be a portion of jackals.
But the king will rejoice in God; all of the swearers by him will exult, for the mouth of speakers of falsehood will be shut.
Hear my voice, God, in my complaint. Preserve my life from fear of the enemy.
Hide me from the council of evildoers, from the throng of the workers of iniquity,
who have sharpened their tongue like a sword. They tread their arrow, a bitter word,
to shoot the innocent from secret places; suddenly they shoot, and they do not fear.
They strengthen for themselves an evil matter; they recount hiding snares. They say, “Who will see them?”
They devise iniquities. “We have perfected a well-devised device!” Both the inside of man and the heart {are} deep.
But God will shoot an arrow; suddenly their wounds will happen.
And they will make it stumble over them, their tongue. Everyone seeing them will flee.
And all of mankind will fear, and they will declare the work of God, for they will consider his deed.
The righteous will rejoice in Yahweh and take refuge in him, and all of the upright of heart will celebrate.
Praise {is in} silence toward you, God, in Zion, and to you a vow will be paid.
Hearer of prayer, to you all flesh will come.
Matters of iniquities prevail against me; our transgressions, you, you cover them.
The happinesses of {the one} you choose and bring near, that he may dwell {in} your courts! May we be full of the goodness of your house, the holiness of your temple.
Doing fearsome things, you answer us in righteousness, God of our salvation, the confidence of all of the ends of the earth and the distant seas,
the one establishing mountains by his strength, being girded with might;
the one stilling the roar of the seas, the roar of their waves, and the tumult of the peoples.
And the dwellers of the ends fear at your signs; you make the goings forth of the morning and the evening shout joyfully.
You visit the earth and saturate it; you greatly enrich it. The channel of God {is} full of water; you prepare their grain, for thus you prepare it.
Watering its furrows, settling its ridges, you soften it with showers; you bless its growth.
You crown the year {with} your goodness, and your tracks drip fatness.
The pastures of the wilderness drip, and the hills gird on rejoicing.
The meadows put on a flock, and the valleys cover {themselves} {with} grain. They shout joyfully; indeed, they sing.
For the chief musician; a song; a psalm. Shout to God, all of the earth!
Make music {to} the glory of his name; make his praise glorious.
Say to God, “How fearsome {are} your deeds! Because of the greatness of your power, your enemies cringe before you.
All of the earth bows down to you and makes music to you; they make music {to} your name.” Selah
Come and see the works of God, fearsome in doing toward the sons of man.
He turned the sea into dry land; they passed through the river on foot. There let us rejoice in him!
He is ruling by his might forever; his eyes watch over the nations. Let the ones rebelling not exalt themselves. Selah
Bless our God, peoples, and make the sound of his praise heard,
the one putting our soul among the living, and he does not allow our foot to slip.
For you tested us, God; you refined us like the refining of silver.
You brought us into a net; you put pressure on our loins.
You made man ride over our head; we went through fire and through waters, but you brought us out to abundance.
I will come {into} your house with burnt offerings; I will pay my vows to you,
{for} which my lips opened and my mouth spoke when trouble {was} to me.
I will offer up burnt offerings of fatlings to you with the smoke of rams; I will offer cattle with male goats. Selah
Come, listen, and let me recount, all fearers of God, what he has done for my soul.
I called to him {with} my mouth, and he was exalted from my tongue.
If I had regarded iniquity in my heart, the Lord would not have heard.
Surely God has heard; he has attended to the voice of my prayer.
Blessed {be} God, who has not turned away my prayer or his covenant faithfulness from me.
May God be gracious to us and bless us; may he make his face shine on us, Selah
for the knowing of your way on the earth, your salvation among all of the nations.
May the peoples thank you, God; may the peoples thank you, all of them.
May the nations rejoice and shout joyfully, for you judge the peoples {with} uprightness, and the nations on the earth, you guide them. Selah
May the peoples thank you, God; may the peoples thank you, all of them.
The earth has given its produce; may God, our God, bless us.
May God bless us, and may all of the ends of the earth fear him.
Let God arise, let his enemies scatter, and let the ones hating him flee from his face.
As smoke is driven away, drive {them} away; as wax melts from the face of fire, let the wicked perish from the face of God.
But let the righteous rejoice, let them exult to the face of God, and let them be glad with rejoicing.
Sing to God, make music {to} his name, lift up to the one riding over the plains. In Yah {is} his name; yes, exult to his face.
A father of orphans and a judge of widows {is} God in the abode of his holiness.
God is making the lonely dwell in a house; he is bringing out prisoners into prosperity. But the ones rebelling dwell in dryness.
God, when you went out to the face of your people, when you marched in the wilderness, Selah
the earth quaked; indeed, the heavens dripped from the face of God; this Sinai, from the face of God, the God of Israel.
A rain of generosities you shook out, God; your inheritance, when it was wearied, you, you established it.
Your flock dwelt in it; in your goodness, you prepared for the poor, God.
The Lord utters the word; the {women} proclaiming good news {are} a great army.
Kings of armies flee, they flee, and the habitation of the house, she divides the spoil.
Though you lie down between the sheepfolds, the wings of a dove covered with silver and its feathers, with greenness of gold.
When Shaddai scattered kings in it, it snowed on Zalmon.
Mount Bashan {is} a mountain of God; Mount Bashan {is} a mountain of peaks.
Why do you look enviously, mountains, peaks, {at} the mountain God desired for his dwelling? Indeed, Yahweh will inhabit {it} forever.
The chariotry of God {is} two myriads, thousands of repetition. The Lord {is} among them; Sinai {is} in the holy {place}.
You have ascended to the height, you have taken captivity captive, you have received gifts among men and even {among} the ones rebelling, that Yah God might dwell {there}.
Blessed {be} the Lord! Day, day he bears for us, the God of our salvation. Selah
God {is} to us a God of salvations, and to Yahweh the Lord {are} exits from death.
Surely God will crush the head of his enemies, the pate of hair of the one walking ahead in his trespasses.
The Lord said, “I will bring back from Bashan, I will bring back from the depths of the sea,
so that your foot may smash in blood, the tongue of your dogs, its portion from the enemies.”
They see your processions, God, the processions of my God, my king, into the holy {place}.
The singers go ahead; the ones playing stringed instruments, behind, maidens playing timbrels, in the midst.
Bless God in the assemblies, Yahweh, from the fountain of Israel.
There {is} Benjamin, the littlest, ruling them; the princes of Judah, their throngs; the princes of Zebulun, the princes of Naphtali.
Your God has commanded your strength. Be strong, God! You have done this for us.
Because of your temple over Jerusalem, kings will bring a gift to you.
Rebuke the beast of the reed, the assembly of the mighty with the calves of the peoples, humbling himself with pieces of silver. He scatters the peoples {who} delight in battles.
Nobles will come from Egypt; Cush will make its hands run to God.
Kingdoms of the earth, sing to God! Make music {to} the Lord, Selah
to the rider on the heavens, of the heavens of antiquity. Behold, he utters with his voice, a voice of power.
Ascribe strength to God; his majesty {is} over Israel, and his strength {is} in the clouds.
God, {you are} fearsome from your sanctuary! The God of Israel, he is giving strength and forces to the people. Blessed {be} God!
Save me, God, for waters have come up to {my} life.
I have sunk in mire of depth, and there is no standing. I have come into depths of waters, and a flood overflows me.
I am weary in my calling out; my throat is parched. My eyes fail {as} I am waiting for my God.
The ones hating me gratuitously are more than the hairs of my head. The ones destroying me are mighty, my enemies of falsehood. What I did not steal, yet I must restore.
God, you, you know my foolishness, and my sins are not hidden from you.
May the ones waiting for you not have shame because of me, Lord Yahweh of Armies. May the ones seeking you not be humiliated because of me, God of Israel.
For because of you I have borne reproach; humiliation has covered my face.
I have become a stranger to my brothers and a foreigner to the sons of my mother.
For zeal for your house has consumed me, and the reproaches of the ones reproaching you have fallen on me.
Though I wept {in} my soul with fasting, yet it became reproaches to me;
though I made my clothing sackcloth, yet I became a proverb to them.
The sitters at the gate speak about me, and the songs of the drinkers of beer.
But I, my prayer {is} to you, Yahweh. {At} a time of favor, God, in the greatness of your covenant faithfulness, answer me in the truth of your salvation.
Deliver me from the mire, and let me not sink. Let me be delivered from the ones hating me and from the depths of the waters.
Let the flood of waters not overflow me, and let the deep not swallow me, and let the pit not close its mouth over me.
Answer me, Yahweh, for your covenant faithfulness {is} good; according to the greatness of your compassion, turn to me.
And may you not hide your face from your servant, for trouble {is} to me; hurry, answer me.
Draw near to my soul, redeem it; because of my enemies, ransom me.
You, you know my reproach and my shame and my humiliation. All of my adversaries {are} before you.
Reproach has broken my heart, and I am sick. Though I waited for sympathy, yet there was none, and for comforters, yet I did not find.
But they put gall in my food, and they made me drink vinegar for my thirst.
Let their table become a snare to their faces and a trap for their welfare.
Let their eyes darken from seeing, and make their loins tremble continually.
Pour your indignation on them, and let the burning of your nose overtake them.
Let their encampment be deserted; let there not be a dweller in their tents.
For you, whom you have struck, they have persecuted, and they talk about the pain of your wounded.
Add iniquity to their iniquity, and let them not come into your righteousness.
Let them be wiped from the book of the living, and let them not be written with the righteous.
But I {am} poor and feeling pain; may your salvation, God, set me on high.
I will praise the name of God with a song, and I will magnify him with thanksgiving.
And this will be better to Yahweh than an ox, a bull having horns and having hooves.
The poor will see, they will rejoice; seekers of God, let your heart live.
For Yahweh is hearing the needy, and he does not despise his prisoners.
Let the heavens and the earth praise him, the seas and everything moving in them.
For God will save Zion, and he will build the cities of Judah, that they may dwell there and possess it.
And the seed of his servants will inherit it, and the ones loving his name will dwell in it.
Hurry, God, to deliver me, Yahweh, to my help!
Let the ones seeking my life have shame and have confusion; let the ones delighting in my harm be turned back and disgraced.
Let them turn back on account of their shame, the ones saying, “Aha! Aha!”
Let all of the seekers of you rejoice and be glad in you, and let the lovers of your salvation say continually, “God is great!”
But I {am} poor and needy; God, hurry to me! You {are} my help and my deliverer; Yahweh, do not delay!
In you, Yahweh, I take refuge; let me not ever have shame.
In your righteousness, deliver me and rescue me; incline your ear to me and save me.
Be to me a rock of abode for coming continually; you command to save me, for you {are} my rock and my stronghold.
My God, rescue me from the hand of the wicked, from the palm of the one doing wrong and the one being cruel;
for you {are} my hope, Lord Yahweh, my confidence from my youth.
I have supported myself on you from the womb; you were taking me from the belly of my mother. My praise {is} about you continually.
I have become like a wonder to many, but you {are} my refuge of strength.
Let my mouth be filled {with} your praise, all of the day {with} your splendor.
May you not cast me away in the time of old age; may you not forsake me when my strength fails.
For my enemies have spoken against me, and the ones watching my life have consulted together,
saying, “God has forsaken him; pursue and seize him, for there is none delivering.”
God, may you not be far from me; my God, hasten to my help.
Let them shame and finish, the adversaries of my life; let them cover {with} reproach and disgrace, the ones seeking my harm.
But I, I will hope continually, and I will add to all of your praise.
My mouth will recount your righteousness, all of the day, your salvation, for I do not know the numbers.
I will come in the forces of Lord Yahweh; I will remember your righteousness, yours alone.
God, you have taught me from my youth, and to this I declare your wonderful doings.
And also until old age and gray hair, God, do not forsake me, until I declare your arm to a generation, your might to everyone {who} will come.
For your righteousness, God, {is} to height, {you} who do great {things}; God, who {is} like you?
{You} who have made me see many and evil troubles, may you return, may you revive me, and may you return, may you bring me up from the depths of the earth.
May you increase my greatness, and may you turn around, may you comfort me.
Also I, I will praise you with the instrument of the lute {for} your faithfulness, my God; Let me make music to you with the harp, Holy {One} of Israel.
My lips will shout joyfully when I make music to you, and my soul, which you have redeemed.
Also my tongue will meditate {on} your righteousness all of the day, for they will shame, for they will confound the ones seeking my harm.
Of Solomon. God, give your judgments to the king and your righteousness to the son of the king.
May he judge your people with righteousness and your poor with justice.
May the mountains bring peace to the people, and the hills, in righteousness.
May he judge the poor of the people; may he save the sons of the needy, and may he crush the oppressor.
May they fear you with the sun and to the face of the moon, generation of generations.
May he come down like rain on mown grass, like showers, a drenching of the earth.
May the righteous flourish in his days, and abundance of peace until the moon {is} not.
May he rule from sea to sea and from the River to the ends of the earth.
May desert-dwellers kneel to his face, and may his enemies lick the dust.
May the kings of Tarshish and the coastlands return tribute; may the kings of Sheba and Seba bring near a gift.
And may all kings bow down to him; may all nations serve him.
For may he deliver the needy crying out and the poor when no helper {is} to him.
May he have pity on the weak and the needy, and may he save the lives of the needy.
May he redeem their life from oppression and from violence, and may their blood be precious in his eyes.
May he live! And may one give to him from the gold of Sheba, and may one pray for him continually; may they bless him all of the day.
May there be an abundance of grain in the land; on the head of the mountains may its fruit sway like Lebanon, and may they flourish from the city like the grass of the earth.
May his name be forever; may his name continue to the face of the sun. And may they be blessed by him; may all of the nations acclaim him.
Blessed {be} Yahweh God, the God of Israel, the one doing wonders, he alone.
And blessed {be} the name of his glory forever, and let all of the earth be filled {with} his glory. Amen and amen.
The prayers of David son of Jesse are finished.
A psalm of Asaph Surely God is good to Israel, to those with a pure heart.
verses.heading: Book Three

verses.text: But as for me, my feet almost slipped; my steps almost were caused to slide out {from under me}
because I was envious of the arrogant {when} I saw the prosperity of the wicked.
For {they have} no ropes until their death, and their belly is fat.
They {are} free from the trouble of man, and with {the rest of} man they are not afflicted.
Therefore pride is a necklace for them; a garment of violence covers them.
Their eyes bulge out from fatness; the imaginations of {their} heart overflow.
They mock and speak with evil of oppression; they speak from an elevated place.
They set their mouth in the heavens, and their tongue goes through the earth.
Therefore his people turn here, and waters of a full {cup} are drained by them.
And they say, “How does God know? And is there knowledge in the Most High?”
Behold, these wicked; they are always at ease, they increase in wealth.
Surely in vain I have kept my heart clean and washed my hands in innocence.
For I have been stricken all of the day and punished every morning.
If I had said, “I will recount such things,” behold, I would have betrayed the generation of your children.
And {when} I thought {how} to understand this, it {was} troublesome in my eyes
until I went into the sanctuaries of God, {then} I discerned their end.
Surely you set them in slippery places; you make them fall to destruction.
How they are {brought} to desolation as in a moment! They come to an end, they perish by terrors.
Like a dream after {one} awakes, Lord, when you rouse {yourself}, you will despise their image.
When my heart was embittered, and I was pierced in my kidneys,
I {was} stupid and I was not knowing; I was an animal with you.
Yet I {am} continuously with you; you hold {me} by my right hand.
You guide me with your counsel, and afterward you will take me {to} glory.
Whom have I in heaven {but you}? And besides you {there is} nothing on the earth I desire.
My flesh and my heart fail, {but} God {is} the rock of my heart and my portion forever.
For behold, those who are far from you will perish; you destroy every one being unfaithful to you.
But {for} me, the closeness of God for me {is} good. I have made the Lord, Yahweh, my refuge in order to recount all your works.
A maskil. Of Asaph. Why, God, have you rejected {us} forever? {Why} does your nose smoke against the flock of your pasture?
Remember your congregation {that} you acquired {in} antiquity, {which} you redeemed, the tribe of your inheritance, this Mount Zion on which you have dwelt.
Lift up your feet to the destructions of perpetuity, {to} all the enemy has damaged in the holy place.
Your adversaries roared in the midst of your meeting place; they set up their signs {as} signs.
It was known like one bringing upward axes in a thicket of trees.
And now with hatchet and hammers they have broken down its carvings altogether.
They sent your holy place into fire; they profaned the dwelling of your name to the ground.
They said in their heart, “Let us oppress them altogether.” They burned all of the meeting places of God in the land.
We do not see our signs; there is no longer a prophet and not one with us knowing until when.
Until when, God, will the adversary reproach? Will the enemy despise your name forever?
Why do you hold back your hand, even your right hand? From the midst of your bosom finish {them}!
But God {is} my king from antiquity, working salvations in the midst of the earth.
You, you divided the sea by your strength; you broke the heads of the sea monsters in the waters.
You, you crushed the heads of Leviathan; you gave him {as} food to a people, to the desert-dwellers.
You, you split open spring and wadi; you, you dry up perpetual rivers.
The day {is} to you; the night {is} also to you. You, you established the light and the sun.
You, you set all of the boundaries of the earth; summer and winter, you, you formed them.
Remember this: the enemy has reproached Yahweh, and a foolish people has despised your name.
May you not give the life of your dove to a beast; may you not forget the life of your poor forever.
Regard the covenant, for pastures of violence fill the dark places of the land.
May the weak not return ashamed; may the poor and the needy praise your name.
Arise, God! Plead your case! Remember your reproach from the fool all of the day.
Do not forget the voice of your adversaries, the uproar of the ones rising against you, going up continually.
We give thanks to you, God; we give thanks, and your name is near; they recount your wonders.
When I take the appointed time; I, I will judge {with} equity.
The earth and all its inhabitants are melting; I, I established its pillars. Selah
I said to the boasters, “Do not boast,” and to the wicked, “Do not lift up a horn.
Do not lift up your horn to the height, or speak with an arrogant neck.”
For not from the east or from the west, and not from the wilderness {comes} lifting up.
For God {is} the judge; this one he brings low, and this one he lifts up.
For a cup {is} in the hand of Yahweh, and the wine foams, a full mixture, and he pours out from this; surely its dregs they will drain; all the wicked of the earth will drink.
But I, I will declare to eternity; I will sing praise to the God of Jacob.
“And all the horns of the wicked I will cut off; the horns of the righteous will be lifted up.”
In Judah God is known; in Israel his name is great.
And his abode is in Salem, and his dwelling place is in Zion.
There he broke the flames of the bow, the shield, and the sword, and the battle. Selah
You are shining, majestic, from the mountains of prey.
The stout of heart were plundered; they slept their sleep, and all of the men of strength found not their hands.
At your rebuke, O God of Jacob, both rider and horse fell deeply asleep.
You, you are to be feared, and who can stand before your face from the time of your nose?
From heaven you caused judgment to be heard; the earth feared and was quiet
when God arose to judgment, to save all the humble of the earth. Selah
For the wrath of man will thank you; the remainder of wrath you will gird on.
Vow and pay to Yahweh your God; let all who are around him bring a gift to the Fear.
He cuts off the spirit of princes; he is to be feared by the kings of the earth.
